## Natural history notes

A large, nonnative mammal characterized by its stocky body, coarse dark fur, long snout, short legs, and tusks in adults. In Florida, it is found in forests, swamps, marshes, pine flatwoods, agricultural areas, pastures, and other habitats with food, water, and cover. It is an omnivore that feeds on roots, acorns, fruits, crops, insects, small animals, and carrion, often disturbing soil and vegetation while rooting and wallowing.
